Quick answer

What is AI for digital and IT teams? The useful kind starts with trust in the records. IT estates run on licences, cloud accounts, vendor contracts and invoices that sit with IT, procurement and finance, and they drift apart. Neural Horizons AI uses Zonar OS™ to check them against each other and HALU™ to brief each owner, with a person approving every action.

Who is it for? CIOs, CTOs, heads of digital, procurement and finance leaders in the UAE and GCC who run many tools, vendors and cloud accounts and want to know what they pay for, what is used and what is governed.

Why not just buy a tool?

Spend tools show the bill.
They do not settle who is right.

SaaS and cloud spend tools give IT and finance a view. The gaps appear when the contract, the usage and the invoice are compared.

FAQ

Digital and IT: common questions.

Where do IT and digital teams lose money between departments?+
Mostly in the gaps between IT, procurement and finance: licences and seats that are paid for and not used, vendor invoices that do not match contracts or usage, renewals nobody approved, cloud bills that outrun budget, and tools adopted by business units without review.
Can AI help with AI governance?+
Yes, when it is built so people stay in control. Zonar OS verifies records, HALU briefs the owner of each gap, your team approves every action that matters, and every action is logged. That gives you an audit trail for agents as well as for spend.
Do we need to replace our tools?+
No. Zonar OS works from exports your systems already produce, with read-only access. Each client gets a separate, secured workspace.
Is a human in the loop?+
Yes. HALU drafts, flags and escalates. Your team approves every action that matters, and every run, read and decision is logged.
Does it use an LLM or RAG, and can it hallucinate?+
The checking is deterministic, so the same files give the same findings. A large language model explains verified findings using retrieval-augmented generation over the verified evidence, and answers cite their source rows. If an answer is not in the verified data, HALU says so.
Which checks are live today?+
The Operations Gap Check, which matches orders, invoices and deliveries, is the first live module. Checks on licences, usage and vendor invoices are scoped with each client in a pilot.
Is our data kept confidential?+
Yes. We start under an NDA, work from read-only extracts, and provide a one-page data handling note. Every client has a separate workspace with role-based access, Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and an audit trail.
